brief.Goal (one sentence): Every campus team posts a recap that looks like part of one movement.
brief.Deliverables: One 30 s 9:16 recap per campus (8), same look, fonts and end card
brief.Must-say copy / CTA: Campus name; Campus Invasion; next stop
brief.Audio: One cleared track for the series; captions burned in
brief.Look & feel references: Chibuzor / Fibman Beats / Kobbyshots phone-first; Mks.Vision 2-second hook

panels.title: Hook
panels.action: Motion in frame 1: a crowd shout, a jump, a door flung open.

panels.title: Moments
panels.action: Worship, conversations, prayer, fun; 1–2 s each.

panels.title: Message
panels.action: One line from a student, captioned.

hardRules: Same grade, fonts, lower thirds and end card for every campus.
Each team's footage and copy go in props; the template never changes per team.
Only the cleared series track; no copyrighted music.
visualNotes: Recipe: phone-first-volume + hook-2s. One props file per campus: jobs/<id>/props/<campus>.json.
qaChecklist: A contact sheet of all 8 recaps shows one consistent look.
Frame 1 has motion in every recap.
Captions burned in and readable at phone size.
